meta.title: Prompt Refinement
meta.description: Turn a half-thought-out line in the input box into a complete instruction the AI can actually follow — one click, rewritten in place, never sent, one-click undo. Four editable presets (general / code / writing / translation), one button each, and you choose which buttons show up. It can read the last few turns of the conversation to work out what "that thing I just mentioned" refers to, and it can either follow the current conversation's model or use one you pin.
